summary: Fully reviewed and repaired15questions and2exercises: IRSA/KMS, VPC CNI, current policy APIs, AL2023, IPv6, Windows, IMDS, safe bootstrap and scoped lab lifecycle.
findings: IRSA trust missing aud; stale aws-auth administrator guidance; unqualified isolation/credential claims.
Security groups question ambiguous with SGP; minimum/default rules conflated; inline YAML inside Bash.
VPC CNI NetworkPolicy support incorrectly denied; unsafe unconfigured alternative CNI install/chaining; duplicate YAML documents without separator and no DNS/egress allowance.
Encryption question ignores modern default envelope encryption; creates KMS key twice.
Existing encryption update claim contradictory; universal service-principal KMS policy; plaintext-secret dumping; Secrets Manager integration incorrectly requires every app changed.
Kubelet configuration uses AL2/bootstrap and invalid eksctl --kubelet-extra-args/kubeletExtraArgs, hardcoded pod density and missing eviction-map semantics.
Policy engines use floating installers, old ConstraintTemplate v1beta1 and missing YAML separator; policies omit init/ephemeral containers and broad-scope prerequisites.
IRSA repeats stale fixed thumbprint and missing aud trust condition.
Removed kubectl run --serviceaccount flag and unscoped s3 ls proof; IRSA setup order overstated.
Logging commands omit eksctl --approve; mutually exclusive configurations sequential; audit logs falsely allactivities.
Node instance-type change blanket restriction ignores launch-template path; badly corrupted code fences, unsafe bulk drains/deletes, incomplete Deployment.
Taints quiz has multiple correct answers; AWS API uses NO_SCHEDULE/PREFER_NO_SCHEDULE/NO_EXECUTE, not Kubernetes casing; manual-removal reconciliation claim needs qualification.
Toleration alone does not dedicate placement; GPU example has no GPU limit/plugin assumptions and YAML inside Bash.
IRSA exercise grants broad AmazonS3ReadOnlyAccess despite one-bucket requirement, missing aud, unsafe reused-role attachment/deletion, publicdefault namespace, latestAWSCLI.
Security exercise creates two KMSkeys and needless newcluster with invalid subnet argument; unguarded endpoint switch/defaultnamespace denyall; no egress/DNS allowance; fleet-wide Kyverno policy.
Read-only LBC IAM policy cannot operate controller; maxUnavailable does not schedule periodic replacement; endpointrestriction not authorization guarantee.

IPv6 requirements omit Nitro/support constraints; oldCNI1.10 installer could downgrade; settingENABLE_IPV6 does not convert existingIPv4cluster; serviceCIDR fixedclaim and noNAT/egressonlyIGW absolute wrong.
Customnetworking IPs remain in VPC-associatedsecondaryCIDR, not outside VPC; notoverlapprevention guarantee; needsENIConfig sameAZ,plannednode rollout,prefixdensity/addonownership.
Windows question stale1.14/1.23 baseline and2019only; kubeproxyrunsWindows, Linuxneed notAmazonLinuxmanagedgroup; obsolete resourcecontroller/webhook manifests.
Advanced Windows Q3 duplicated; on-startIISinstallation and unsignedServiceMonitordownload, old2019image; hostNetworkblanketclaimignoresHostProcess.

IMDS examples invalid eksctl launchtemplateflags/metadataOptions; inheriteddefaults notalways1; requirementIMDSv2 notuniversalSSRFprevention, ad-hocPREROUTINGeth0DNAT ineffectivePodisolation; disablingIMDS canbreaknode/CNI.

Bootstrap uses unverifiedlatestRPM/roottracing, tuningnumbers assertedoptimization, unsafe mkfs arbitrarynvme1n1/fstab, ad-hocfirewall/sshdedits, invalid kubeletExtraArgs and CoreDNSmisclassifiedascontrolplane.
Official Kyverno1.19.1 CLI warns ClusterPolicy is deprecated; verifying CEL alternative before updating policy-engine examples.
Resolved every recorded question/exercise defect. Kept original kernel tuning values explicitly unvalidated; did not claim runtime performance.
The original eksctl kubernetesNetworkConfig.ipFamily:IPv6 spelling was valid and preserved; clarified its distinction from the EKS API lowercase value.
Current policy example migrated to policies.kyverno.io/v1 after actualCLI deprecation warning; legacy types deprecated1.19 and scheduled removal1.20 per official migration guide.
validation: Sequential full read1–400,401–800,801–1200,1201–1600,1601–2000,2001–2498. No document commands executed.

Final paired validation:88Bash,10JSON,16eksctl configs,32native Kubernetes objects,4custom-schema checks,10vendor examples,6fragments,2MIME blocks and4local links;15answers/17details per locale; full code parity and scoped diff pass.

Actual offline policy tests:Kyverno1.19.1 CEL ValidatingPolicy v1 with warnings-as-errors andGatekeeper3.23.1 Gator,6cases each. LegacyKyverno6case evidence retained separately. Charts3.9.1/3.23.1 rendered locally forKubernetes1.36.
IRSA workflow:7mocked flow cases+9cleanup cases. Security workflow:11mocked flow cases+4cleanup cases. TwoMIME/base64 encoding cases. Dynamic generated manifests checked againstKubernetes1.36.0.
No actual AWS provisioning/configuration, node bootstrap, Pod networking, image execution or benchmark. Evidence:/tmp/eks-creation-part2-audit/validation.json and referenced artifacts.
